correctness.rationale: Independent exhaustive replay uses the chosen set of spokes to cut the two 12-cycles into paths. Each even path has one perfect matching, each odd path has none, and an uncut cycle has two options. This generates the 120 matching masks without duplicates by a different decomposition from the frozen scripts. Pairs of internally disjoint equal-length paths catalogue the 4-, 6- and 8-cycles: 0, 12 and 54. All 7140 matching-pair differences were tested against the cycle catalogues; when the difference is a single cycle it alternates automatically. The frozen certificate's matching, cycle and adjacency data agree entrywise. Complete distance-layer searches recover 192 hexagon edges, components 57, 18, 18, 18 and nine singletons, and radius and diameter 6 for each nonsingleton. The 414 additional edges give 606 total, connected, with radius 4, diameter 6, eccentricities {4:96,5:18,6:6} and degree distribution as stated; the hexagon degree distribution also agrees. The graph is bipartite by opposite parity conventions on its two layers. The six-cycle cells meet twice at every edge with triangular vertex links and consistent opposite face orientations; the connected closed orientable surface has Euler characteristic 24−36+12=0. This verifies the facial interpretation and the sharp length cutoff.
residual_risks: The check is complete for this finite graph only. It makes no claim about general toroidal polyhexes or minimum allowed flip length on other graphs.

It supplies the same hexagon fragmentation and separately computes both edge layers on the identical, common indexed matchings. Its stated octagon-only eccentricity profile is not the frozen combined profile. But its supplied exact-layer construction materially covers the combined statistic: set A[i]=build(6)[i] ∪ build(8)[i], then apply its existing neighbor counts and distance routines. This is a mechanical union and tabulation on already specified exact adjacency data, not a new threshold or reconfiguration result. This comparison does not establish priority from dates.
residual_risks: No claim about historical priority or copied work follows from dated paths. Which parameters in the general polyhex count yield the nine singleton matchings was not needed or verified. The cumulative eccentricity distribution is not the exact-length-eight distribution.

value.rationale: The first cutoff for connectivity on a standard toroidal hexagonal graph is a worthwhile invariant. It is already settled by octagon-only connectivity and hexagon-only fragmentation. The remaining difference is the standard component and distance census of the union of the two fully available layers, which by itself is a mechanically implied finite bookkeeping refinement, not a surviving independently useful unknown invariant under the review standard.
residual_risks: This is not a rejection of finite exhaustive proofs or of the motivation of the cutoff. A genuinely different move restriction or a new structural explanation would require a separate claim and assessment.
